verdict.rationale: Nitrokey is a hardware security key and HSM product with a local CLI (nitropy). It has no hosted API service whose credentials could be issued or scoped for an agent, so this story is a category error for the product type. Nothing in the evidence shows a scoped API-token issuance capability that would make the axis apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
